body:
OBSERVED 2026-09-26 by the independent review of #2313 (probe through the real sync handler at
3b46f2353): changing only cover.jpg's file mtime re-sent the book to the Kobo as a
ChangedEntitlement. The entitlement payload carries a cover identifier derived from the cover
file's time, and the per-device ledger fingerprints the payload.

Consequence: a library copied or restored without preserving file times (rsync without -t,
some backup restores, a move between volumes) makes every book with a cover look Changed to
every Kobo once. Each held book is re-downloaded and its reading position is lost (the #1925
class). The Kobo-facing host name is in the payload as well, so changing the external URL has
the same effect.

Not yet measured: which exact field (CoverImageId vs the image URL) carries the mtime, and
whether the host is inside the fingerprinted part. Start from create_book_entitlement /
get_metadata in cps/kobo.py. Fix shape: exclude transport-only values from
_fingerprint_projection, as DownloadUrls[].Size already is, behind a declared schema
transition so the reseed path suppresses the one-time mismatch.
title: A cover file's modification time reaches the Kobo entitlement fingerprint
